text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaaaaat!? It's absolutely pouring 
raaaaaaaain!?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawa, it's so white out I can't even 
see the grounds...! At this rate, today's 
training willâ
choice_data_list: I might not be able to do this...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
What am I gonna dooo?! And here I was, 
planning to run with Taishin today~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I don't remember making any promise 
like that.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Can't you do something to make it 
sunny?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Because at this rate, I won't be able to 
run with Taishin, waaahhhhh!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That's why I... *sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, there's no way you can just 
change the weather."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Is it really no good? Really impossible?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket is looking over here with 
eyes full of anticipation.
choice_data_list: Shall we make a teru teru bozu?
Let's wait and see for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That's itttttt!! Taishin, let's make it 
together!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Teru teru bozu? What are we, five? I'm not 
doing that.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, but it looks like so much fun! You 
can just watch me make it, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What is that?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Um, the materials are a handkerchief 
and... stuffing? Do you think we have that 
in the trainer's office!? Let's go check, 
let's go!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, look, look! I made so many teru 
teru bozu!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the desk sat a towering mountain of 
teru teru bozu dolls.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"If we're gonna hang them up anyway, 
having a whole bunch is definitely gonna 
work better!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"No... seeing teru teru bozu as far as the 
eye can see is honestly pretty creepy..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Still... Don't you get tired of making so 
many of these?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Tired of it? As long as I have the 
ingredients, I can keep on making more!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm gonna make more and more 
until the sun comes out~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just then, as if the rain had all been a 
lie, sunlight came streaming through the 
window.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOH~, it cleared up! It really 
cleared up! This is the power of the teru 
teru bozu, right!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I haven't even hung it up yet... Are you 
serious...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through making teru teru bozu dolls, 
Winning Ticket demonstrated her sheer 
persistence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: About an hour later—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yaaaaay!! It stopped, it stopped, the rain 
stopped~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the grounds are completely 
muddy... Maybe we should wait and see a 
bit longer—”

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Alright, first I'll do a light run-through 
on my own!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wait, you're not listening to me again!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: "Taishiiiiin, Trainer!! I'm hoooome!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's pretty muddy, but if I just think of 
it as a Heavy track, this is easy-peasy!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"This might actually make for great 
training! I feel like it'll help me build 
up my endurance!"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Right, right, totally! Well then, Taishin, 
let's run!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Come on, go change and get ready, ready!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Liiike I said, I never once said I'd run 
together with you!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Eeeeehhhh!? Was that how it was~~~~!?!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: You bet it isっっ!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: *GASP!!* No waaaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uuuu! And I was so looking forward to it, 
too!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Getting to run with Taishin... *sniff*... 
I'm zzooo happyyyyy~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Aaargh, so annoying! Quit crying already!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*Sniff*... Then... will you run with 
meee!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"No—... Haaah, it's honestly more of a 
pain to refuse at this point."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Not feeling like it today, but sometime 
soon.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaayyyyyyy...!! We did iiiiiiittttt!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yay, yay, we did it!! A promise is a 
promise, you promised, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All righttt! I'm gonna get way faster 
before I run with Taishin~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Simpleton.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while after that, Narita Taishin and 
I watched over Winning Ticket as she made 
a fuss.
